verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents a free, open-source ID/rendezvous (hbbs) and relay (hbbr) server you can deploy on your own infrastructure, with a Docker compose quick start. Several users report running their own lookup/relay servers successfully, though one says self-hosting was nearly impossible. Missing for 10: authentication on the free OSS server (users report it is open to anyone unless placed behind a VPN), with web console, access control and the management API gated to paid Server Pro; mixed hands-on reports of self-hosting difficulty.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Server OSS: a free, open-source ID/rendezvous server (hbbs) and relay server (hbbr) that you can deploy on your own infrastructure.
You can use our rendezvous/relay server, [set up your own](https://rustdesk.com/server), or [write your own rendezvous/relay server]
